facts.evidence: **Net revenue** of **$11.6 billion**, up **14%** year-over-year (13% on a constant-dollar basis).
**GAAP net income** of **$5.6 billion** ($2.97 per share), a **7%** increase
**non-GAAP net income** of **$6.3 billion** ($3.32 per share), up **8%**
**GAAP operating expenses** rose **19%** to **$4.8 billion**, primarily due to personnel costs; **non-GAAP operating expenses** increased **17%**.
**Payments volume** rose **10%** (constant-dollar), with **cross-border volume** (excluding intra-Europe) up **12%**
**Share repurchases and dividends** totaled **$6.2 billion** in the quarter.
**Cash, cash equivalents, and investment securities** totaled **$13.9 billion** as of June 30, 2026.

**Litigation provisions**: Q3 included **$237 million** for interchange multidistrict litigation (MDL) and **$9 million** in equity investment losses, compared to **$615 million** in prior-year litigation provisions.

claims.claim: Net revenue was $11.6 billion in fiscal Q3 2026.
Net revenue increased 14% year-over-year.
Net revenue increased 13% on a constant-dollar basis.
GAAP net income was $5.6 billion.
GAAP earnings per share were $2.97.
GAAP net income increased 7% year-over-year.
Non-GAAP net income was $6.3 billion.
Non-GAAP earnings per share were $3.32.
Non-GAAP net income increased 8% year-over-year.
Payments volume rose 10% year-over-year on a constant-dollar basis.
Cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe rose 12% on a constant-dollar basis.
Total cross-border volume rose 13% on a constant-dollar basis.
Processed transactions were 71.7 billion, a 10% increase.
Share repurchases and dividends totaled $6.2 billion in the quarter.
Service revenue grew 14% to $4.9 billion.
Service revenue is recognized based on prior-quarter payments volume.
Data processing revenue increased 17% to $6.0 billion.
International transaction revenue rose 6% to $3.9 billion.
Other revenue rose 45% to $1.5 billion.
Client incentives climbed 18% to $4.7 billion.
GAAP operating expenses rose 19% to $4.8 billion.
The GAAP operating expense increase was primarily due to personnel costs.
Non-GAAP operating expenses increased 17%.
The release provided no forward guidance.
Cash, cash equivalents and investment securities totaled $13.9 billion as of June 30, 2026.
$28.4 billion remained authorized for share repurchases.
$250 million was deposited into the litigation escrow account in June 2026.
The escrow deposit reduced as-converted share counts with the same economic effect as a repurchase, at a volume-weighted average price of $333.42.
Q3 2026 included a $237 million litigation provision associated with the interchange MDL case.
Q3 2026 included $9 million of net losses from equity investments.
claims.note: Figure and period are correct; note the brief files it under the 'Litigation provisions' bullet, whereas the release treats equity investment losses as a separate non-GAAP adjustment.

claims.claim: The prior-year quarter included a $615 million litigation provision.
Operating expense growth of 19% GAAP and 17% non-GAAP was driven by personnel and marketing costs.
Cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe grew 12% and total cross-border volume grew 13% (restated in Watch Items).
